story.iWant: a core scraping engine with HTTP client, HTML parser, and configuration system
story.soThat: I can reliably extract data from websites with minimal dependencies and maximum performance
story.tasks: - Set up project structure and TypeScript configuration (AC: 5) - Initialize Bun project with TypeScript - Configure tsconfig.json for strict type checking - Set up source directory structure (src/core/, src/types/, etc.) - Configure ESLint with TypeScript support and quality rules - Configure Stryker for mutation testing with 70% threshold - Set up Husky git hooks for code quality - Implement HTTP client with retry logic and rate limiting (AC: 1, 6) - Create HTTP client class using Bun's built-in fetch - Add exponential backoff retry mechanism - Implement rate limiting and request throttling - Add comprehensive error handling for network failures - Build HTML parser using Cheerio for content extraction (AC: 2) - Integrate Cheerio for jQuery-like HTML parsing - Support CSS selectors and XPath expressions - Add data extraction utilities and helpers - Create configuration management system (AC: 3) - Implement YAML/JSON configuration file parsing - Define configuration schema and validation - Add default configuration values and merging logic - Implement data extraction pipeline with CSS selectors (AC: 4) - Create extraction engine that applies selectors to HTML - Support multiple data extraction patterns - Add data transformation and normalization utilities - Add comprehensive error handling and logging (AC: 6) - Implement structured logging system - Add error recovery mechanisms - Create debugging utilities for troubleshooting - Write unit tests for core scraping functionality (AC: 7) - Test HTTP client with mock responses - Test HTML parser with sample documents - Test configuration parsing and validation - Test data extraction pipeline - Write integration tests for end-to-end scraping scenarios (AC: 7) - Test complete scraping workflows - Test error handling in realistic scenarios - Test configuration-driven scraping - Configure mutation testing with Stryker (AC: 7) - Run initial mutation test to establish baseline - Achieve minimum 70% mutation score threshold - Fix any surviving mutants by improving test coverage

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. HTTP client can fetch web pages with proper error handling and retry logic 2. HTML parser can extract data using CSS selectors and XPath 3. Configuration system supports YAML/JSON files with scraping rules 4. Data extraction pipeline can transform raw HTML into structured data 5. Library provides clean TypeScript API for programmatic usage 6. Error handling gracefully manages network failures and parsing errors 7. Core functionality is fully tested with unit and integration tests

doc.title: Epic Breakdown - Web Scraping Library Foundation
doc.snippet: Phase 1: Core Foundation (Story 1) - Project setup and TypeScript configuration, HTTP client implementation with retry logic, HTML parsing using Cheerio, Configuration management system, Basic data extraction pipeline

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Core modules: src/core/scraper.ts (Main scraping engine), src/core/parser.ts (HTML/XML parsing), src/core/extractor.ts (Data extraction logic), src/core/config.ts (Configuration management)

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Architecture Pattern: Modular library with clear separation between core scraping logic, CLI interface, and export functionality. Core Design Principles: Composable Design, Configuration-Driven, Async/Await Throughout, Error Resilience, Type Safety

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Core Runtime: Bun v1.3.1+, TypeScript v5.9.3+. HTML Parsing: cheerio v1.1.2+. Testing & Quality: Bun's built-in test runner, eslint v9.38.0+, @stryker-mutator/core v9.2.0+

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: ESLint with TypeScript support: @typescript-eslint/parser v8.46.2+, @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin v8.46.2+. Rules: no-unused-vars, no-explicit-any, prefer-const, strict type checking

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Mutation testing with Bun test runner, 70% threshold, per-test coverage analysis. Reporters: progress, clear-text, html, dashboard

doc.title: Product Brief
doc.snippet: CLI tool for easy installation, Bun-based library with clean API, Configuration file support (YAML/JSON), Data export in CSV and JSON formats, Support for static websites, Comprehensive error handling and retry mechanisms

constraints.constraint: Use Bun v1.3.1+ as primary runtime
Implement full TypeScript with strict type checking
Include comprehensive error handling with retry logic
Support both YAML and JSON configuration formats
Maintain 90%+ test coverage for core modules
ESLint must pass with zero warnings (lint:check)
Stryker mutation score threshold: minimum 70% to break, 75% low, 90% high
Follow tech-spec.md source tree structure exactly

tests.standards: Bun's built-in test runner for unit and integration testing. Minimum 90% test coverage for core modules. ESLint must pass with zero warnings. Stryker mutation testing with 70% threshold. Use fixtures for HTML testing and mock HTTP requests. Coverage analysis: perTest with Stryker.

ideas.test: Test HTTP client retry logic with simulated network failures and timeout scenarios
Test HTML parser with various HTML structures including malformed content and edge cases
Test configuration parsing with valid/invalid YAML and JSON files, schema validation
Test data extraction with complex CSS selectors, nested elements, and XPath expressions
Test TypeScript API types and interfaces for proper type safety and IntelliSense support
Test error handling and logging scenarios including network timeouts, parsing errors, and configuration errors
Test all components individually (unit tests) and integrated end-to-end workflows
